# The Kunnumpurathu Kudumbam

*Puthencavu, Chengannur, Kerala*

The Kunnumpurathu family has its roots in **Puthencavu**, a village on the southern bank of the river Pamba, about two kilometres east of Chengannur in the Alappuzha district of Kerala. The family name itself — *Kunnumpurathu* — speaks of the land: "upon the hill".

Over the generations the kudumbam has grown into several branches, among them the **Kochuveettil** branch, each with its own homes, stories and distinguished members.

## Notable members

- **K. G. Kurien** — biblical scholar and a leader of the Brethren Church.
- **Dr. K. K. Kochukoshy** — former Librarian of the Central Reference Library, Kolkata, and member of the Working Group on Libraries of the National Knowledge Commission, Government of India.

---

*This page is a beginning, not an end. Press “Edit this page” above to correct, expand and enrich the family story — the origins of the tharavad, the branches, the migrations, the church, the land. The fuller account already gathered at kunnumpurathu.com may be copied here and continued.*

A devoted student of family and local history, and the keeper of the Kunnumpurathu family record.
